purpose: Hand-labelled validation set for any instrument claiming to measure whether the applicant was told a specific deferred field is not settled. Labels are one person's reading of each turn individually, not the output of any rule, and are reviewable and arguable. An instrument that cannot separate these should not produce a number.
the_question_to_ask_per_field: Reading only this reply, would the applicant know she has to COME BACK to this specific field before the form is done? Answer per field, not per turn. Note the question is about whether she knows to return, not about whether she understands the field's internal state: a reply that hedges only the precision of a value ('confirm the exact days later') still tells her to return, and counts as told.
hazard: Do NOT give a judge the prompt rule text. A judge handed the rule evaluates the lane against the same words the lane was given, which is reading the instruction back to itself.
second_hazard: Judge and lane are the same model family. The lane wrote these lines believing they communicated. A judge may read them the same way and share the blind spot. The attachment cases below are the test for exactly that: conf-es-v27 t31, conf-v21 t31, conf-v22 t32.

turns.label_note: RECLASSIFIED 2026-09-06 after a judge disagreed with the original 'told'. Two coherent readings and no way to choose: the reply proposes a wording and asks 'does that sound right', which either leaves it awaiting her approval (told) or states it as already working for the form and asks only for assent (not told). Excluded from scoring rather than resolved, because a set that forces a call on a genuinely 50/50 case teaches an instrument to reproduce a coin flip.

turns.label_note: ADJUDICATED 2026-09-06 against a defensible disagreement, label HELD at told. The objection: it states 'October 2017 to June 2020' as if recorded and hedges only 'exact days', not the month and year, so she may not learn the FIELD is unsettled. That distinction is real but it is not the one that matters to her. The test is not whether she knows the field's internal state, it is whether she knows she has to come back to this with a document. 'Noted to confirm exact days later' tells her that. Contrast the attachment failures, where 'y desde junio de 2020' signals nothing outstanding at all and gives her no reason to return. Same reasoning holds conf-v19 t37.

how_to_score: Score PER FIELD, not per turn. An instrument is only interesting if it separates the three ATTACHMENT turns (hedge present, on another field) from the four clause-boundary turns (hedge present, attached, but in the next clause). A regex cannot: clause scoping fails the second group, sentence scoping fails the first. Measured at roughly 40 percent false positives on the known-good sample, which is why no count was published from it.
